name: Riku Fernando Javier
original_name: 陸・フェルナンド・ハビエル
source:
Hobbies: Driving/Racing, Messing around with mechanisms
Favorite Food: Pineapple, Strawberries
Least Favorite Food: Green Peas
Favorite Animal: Dogs
Least Favorite Animal: Crows
Favorite Motto: No rainbow without rain.

First year high school student. 
His father is Spanish his mother is Japanese.
He grew up in Japan and loves anime.
